scripts.test:unit: bun test --coverage packages/auth packages/validation packages/sdk apps/api/src/lib/errors.test.ts apps/api/src/lib/auth-helpers.test.ts apps/api/src/lib/soft-delete.test.ts apps/api/src/lib/audit.test.ts apps/api/src/lib/notify.test.ts apps/api/src/lib/tenant-scope.test.ts apps/api/src/config.test.ts
scripts.test:ci: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e:cypress:manage: start-server-and-test "bun run --filter=@society-hub/manage dev" http://localhost:5174 "bun run --filter=@society-hub/manage test:cypress"
scripts.test:e2e:cypress:client-app: start-server-and-test "bun run --filter=@society-hub/client-app dev" http://localhost:5173 "bun run --filter=@society-hub/client-app test:cypress"
scripts.test:e2e:cypress: bun run test:e2e:cypress:manage && bun run test:e2e:cypress:client-app
scripts.setup: bun install && bun run setup:env && bun run setup:db
